title: Iron and Ink
subtitle: A Novel
author: Walusimbi Leon
description: A railway engineer and a banned newspaper editor flee across a continent by train as an empire collapses — racing to print the truth before the border closes.
style: Rousing, cinematic third-person. Clack of rails, steam, ink on fingers. Momentum and danger.
characters: Tomas — engineer, practical, stubborn; Esin — editor, fearless, fluent in three tongues of resistance.
notes: Open with the last train leaving the capital as crowds riot. Two strangers share a compartment. The chase begins immediately.
